name: @fundroom/e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end tests against the Compose CI stack (deploy/compose/compose.ci.yaml)

scripts.stack:down: docker compose -f ../deploy/compose/compose.ci.yaml down -v && docker image prune -f
scripts.stack:down:acme: docker compose -f ../deploy/compose/compose.ci.yaml -f ../deploy/compose/compose.acme.yaml down -v && docker image prune -f
scripts.stack:down:hosts: docker compose -f ../deploy/compose/compose.ci.yaml -f ../deploy/compose/compose.hosts.yaml down -v && docker image prune -f
scripts.stack:down:pathmount: docker compose -f ../deploy/compose/compose.ci.yaml -f ../deploy/compose/compose.pathmount.yaml down -v && (docker image rm seed-host-ci-worker seed-host-ci-next 2>/dev/null || true) && docker image prune -f
